title: FermiSwap (Ethereum) — prop-AMM desk with provider-posted pricing; corpus inventory-pricing hypothesis refuted; $0 unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: swap pricing is provider-posted (engine4 acee8aab gated 'NP'; one dedicated provider per lane, all still authorized) with same-block freshness ('SP'); not balanceOf(this) spot pricing
inventory only caps the payout (balanceOf(vault) staticcalls in engine) plus a <=0.003% rebalancing term; donation unrecoverable, gain/cost ~1e-7
same-block price impact after a 10 WETH swap: 0.0025% — no sandwich surface
old swapper: stale registry lane (StaleUpdate 0x666a2814) AND vault allowance 0 (double-dead)
vault withdrawals manager-gated ('NM'), engines manager-gated, registry writes NotAuthorized, MAX_UPDATE_AGE=0 kills signature replay
arb executors with ~MAX vault allowances are trader-gated ('NT'); traders are team solver EOAs
permissionless swap path is live but executes at market +-3 bps (measured +0.03% gross), below gas/priority costs
swap-time price band 'PB' blocks single-step manipulated prices beyond ~+45%
key_facts: new FermiSwapper 0x5979458912F80B96d30D4220af8E2e4925A33320 (v20260604, verified) has ~MAX vault allowances for 5 tokens; old FermiSwapper 0xb1076fE3AB5e28005C7c323Bac5AC06a680d452e allowance 0

managers: vault manager 0x7117ca30af85706b964100dd8fbbe78f2fb6d3d8 (P, can sweep all); swapper/engine/arb manager 0xff67d7211d4837607d601e65f27b97622540c47f (both verified by gate simulation at block 26202614)
timeline: swaps Apr 26-Jun 11 (old swapper, 596), new swapper Jun 8, engine4 Sep 7-8, dormant Sep 16 -> Oct 15, re-armed Oct 15 12:46 UTC, actively trading now
conditional: provider-key compromise -> ratchet within 'PB' band (~+45%) -> ~31% of drained quote inventory per epoch (~$0.78M net per epoch on the 2.73M USDC lane, ~708 WETH capital)
caveats: engine4/vault/arb-executor bytecode is unverified; pricing internals reconstructed empirically (band/ratchet bounds empirical, not source-derived)
vault balances fluctuate with live trading; $5.31M is the CI snapshot at block 26202605
provider authorization set can change; PoC tries all 8 known providers for unlock
the 'PB' reference-update rule (what resets the band) was not fully reverse-engineered; walk tests bound per-epoch inflation at ~+45%
E-U categories: no unprivileged extraction exists; the ~$5.31M P number is the vault manager's by-design authority
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live; the corpus 'inventory-priced quote' hypothesis is refuted (prices are provider-posted with same-block freshness; inventory only caps payouts) and every inventory-moving path is gated (NM/NP/NT/NotAuthorized) — residual risk is a provider-key compromise (band-limited drain ~$0.78M/epoch) or the vault manager key (sweeps all, by design).
